summary: Executed 17 backend pytest tests (all passed) and 14 Playwright UI flow checks (all passed). Every acceptance criterion in the review request is met: register auto-provisions a Livepeer stream (verified stream_key, playback_id, rtmp_url='rtmp://rtmp.livepeer.com/live', stream_title, is_live=false); duplicate email/username → 409; login/me flows correct; channel list + category + live_only filters work; public channel endpoint hides stream_key/rtmp_url; PATCH validates category (400 on 'not-a-genre'); go-live toggle works; /channels/mine/sync hits real Livepeer and returns 200; PATCH /users/me mirrors display_name to channel doc; PNG upload returns /api/files/... URL that is readable; /api/categories returns exactly the 10 expected genres. Frontend: Browse renders (grid, hero CTA); Register → Dashboard with masked stream key + reveal toggle, rtmp URL, playback URL; GO LIVE ↔ CUT SIGNAL toggles; title+category persist after reload; public channel page shows OFF AIR when offline; login shows username in nav; /dashboard and /profile redirect to /login when logged out. Zero console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py — @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI; consider migrating to lifespan context manager. Not blocking.
server.py register endpoint deletes user on Livepeer failure but does so non-atomically; acceptable for MVP.
CORS uses allow_credentials=True with allow_origins from env (default '*'); as noted by main agent this is fine since app uses Bearer tokens, no cookies.
test_credentials: testdj@pirate.radio / testpass123 (existing) + one dynamic uitest_<uuid>@pirate.radio user created per run (Livepeer stream provisioned).
seed_data_creation: Each test run creates 1 backend fixture user (test_<hex>@pirate.radio) and 1 UI test user (uitest_<hex>@pirate.radio). Each triggers real Livepeer stream creation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — run with `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. Each register test call hits real Livepeer, so limit runs. testdj@pirate.radio is the shared existing user; its display_name is mutated by TestUsers.test_patch_profile_mirrors_display_name (harmless).
rca of the issue: No issues found — all functionality works as spec'd.
